title: DCP Project Resource Map (.v0)
description: REPO_VALIDATED path/root observations (ARCHITECTURE.md + policy.py canonical_writers + filesystem) / PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT for endpoint bindings. Maps project resources and authority surfaces WITHOUT binding DCP to live endpoints. Endpoint bindings are PROVISIONAL or UNKNOWN only — no live endpoint is encoded as resolved authority. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

contract_id.description: Unique identifier for this contract instance.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance. REPO_VALIDATED: path roots and surface list derived from ARCHITECTURE.md + policy.py + filesystem observation.

state.description: Const-pinned for .v0. Path roots are REPO_VALIDATED but endpoint bindings are PROVISIONAL — the mixed state constrains the contract to PROVISIONAL at .v0.

validation_state.description: Const-pinned for .v0. Endpoint bindings remain PROVISIONAL until runtime proof resolves them.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags for all fields in this resource map instance.

repo_root_marker.description: Expected repo root marker file(s). Both .repo_id and dopetaskroot markers observed in repo.

canonical_source_roots.description: Canonical source code roots observed in the repo. REPO_VALIDATED from ARCHITECTURE.md §3 and filesystem.

schema_roots.description: Schema roots. REPO_VALIDATED from filesystem observation.

test_roots.description: Test roots. REPO_VALIDATED from filesystem observation.

proof_roots.description: Proof artifact roots. REPO_VALIDATED from filesystem observation. Note: proof/ is gitignored; git add -f required.

task_packet_roots.description: Task packet roots. REPO_VALIDATED from filesystem observation.

config_roots.description: Configuration roots. REPO_VALIDATED from policy.py DEFAULT_POLICY_PATH and filesystem.

runtime_authority_pointers.description: Pointers to runtime authority files/paths, per AGENTS.md §2 truth order.

provisional_surfaces.description: Surfaces that are identified but not fully resolved as authority — endpoints, inferred paths, partially observed services.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths that DCP must never import, call, wrap, or wire. Includes DCP-RED-MERGE-SEAM-0001 paths.

red_line_paths.description: Red line path IDs that apply to this resource map.

bridge_proxy_surfaces.description: Bridge and proxy surfaces. REPO_VALIDATED from ARCHITECTURE.md §3.6. These mediate routes but do NOT become domain authority.

memory_context_chronicle_surfaces.description: Memory, context, and chronicle surfaces. REPO_VALIDATED surface list from ARCHITECTURE.md §3.4; endpoints PROVISIONAL.

endpoint_status.description: Endpoint binding status. Must be PROVISIONAL or UNKNOWN — no live endpoint is resolved as truth here.

task_orchestrator_surfaces.description: Task-orchestrator surfaces and capabilities. REPO_VALIDATED from approval_policy.yaml + policy.py. Task-Orchestrator is not DCP authority.

dopetask_surfaces.description: Dopetask wrapper surfaces. REPO_VALIDATED wrapper paths from ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2. External dopetask implementation is out of scope.

github_ci_surfaces.description: GitHub and CI surfaces. REPO_VALIDATED from T5 capabilities in approval_policy.yaml + .github/workflows/ observation.

endpoint_bindings.description: Service endpoint bindings. ALL entries must be PROVISIONAL or UNKNOWN — no live endpoint is encoded as resolved authority per TP-DCP-0002 invariant §11.

host_port_hint.description: Informational hint only — not verified as live authority.

binding_status.description: Must be PROVISIONAL or UNKNOWN. Never REPO_CROSS_CHECKED for endpoint bindings in .v0.

canonical_writers_map.description: Map of resource domains to canonical writers. REPO_VALIDATED from policy.py CapabilityPolicy.canonical_writer fields.

known_unknowns.description: Explicit unresolved unknowns for this resource map.

red_lines.description: Red line IDs that apply to this resource map.
